notes: Variant WLC.JOB.38.41.v003 is selected to the base reading, which the ASV's *his young ones* matches (rule 9).

MACULA's glosses on `יְלָדָיו` are distributed in reverse (*ones* on the noun, *its.young* on the suffix); the surface and morphology were read instead, giving *young ones* to `יֶלֶד`, headed on *young*, and *his* to the suffix (rules 31, 39).
The italic *And* before *wander* answers to no conjunction morpheme and is `added` (rules 7, 14).
